title: Service logs
description: Pod logs of the resource group's managed services, as the resource group's Alloy collects them.

list.name: service
list.label: Service
list.definition: SELECT DISTINCT LogAttributes['managed-services.codesphere.com/id'] FROM otel_logs WHERE $__timeFilter(Timestamp) AND LogAttributes['managed-services.codesphere.com/id'] != ''

query.rawSql: SELECT DISTINCT LogAttributes['managed-services.codesphere.com/id'] FROM otel_logs WHERE $__timeFilter(Timestamp) AND LogAttributes['managed-services.codesphere.com/id'] != ''

list.name: pod
list.label: Pod
list.definition: SELECT DISTINCT LogAttributes['pod'] FROM otel_logs WHERE $__timeFilter(Timestamp) AND LogAttributes['managed-services.codesphere.com/id'] IN (${service:singlequote})

query.rawSql: SELECT DISTINCT LogAttributes['pod'] FROM otel_logs WHERE $__timeFilter(Timestamp) AND LogAttributes['managed-services.codesphere.com/id'] IN (${service:singlequote})

targets.rawSql:
SELECT toStartOfInterval(Timestamp, INTERVAL $__interval_s second) AS time, LogAttributes['managed-services.codesphere.com/id'] AS service, count() / $__interval_s AS value
FROM otel_logs WHERE $__timeFilter(Timestamp) AND LogAttributes['managed-services.codesphere.com/id'] IN (${service:singlequote}) AND LogAttributes['pod'] IN (${pod:singlequote})
GROUP BY time, service ORDER BY time

panels.title: Error lines by service

targets.rawSql:
SELECT toStartOfInterval(Timestamp, INTERVAL $__interval_s second) AS time, LogAttributes['managed-services.codesphere.com/id'] AS service, count() / $__interval_s AS value
FROM otel_logs WHERE $__timeFilter(Timestamp) AND LogAttributes['managed-services.codesphere.com/id'] IN (${service:singlequote}) AND LogAttributes['pod'] IN (${pod:singlequote}) AND multiSearchAnyCaseInsensitive(Body, ['error', 'fatal', 'panic', 'exception'])
GROUP BY time, service ORDER BY time

panels.description: Lines containing error, fatal, panic or exception.

panels.title: Logs

targets.rawSql:
SELECT Timestamp AS timestamp, Body AS body, if(multiSearchAnyCaseInsensitive(Body, ['error', 'fatal', 'panic', 'exception']), 'error', 'info') AS level,
  LogAttributes['managed-services.codesphere.com/id'] AS service, LogAttributes['pod'] AS pod, LogAttributes['container'] AS container
FROM otel_logs
WHERE $__timeFilter(Timestamp) AND LogAttributes['managed-services.codesphere.com/id'] IN (${service:singlequote}) AND LogAttributes['pod'] IN (${pod:singlequote}) AND $__conditionalAll(positionCaseInsensitive(Body, '$search') > 0, $search)
ORDER BY Timestamp DESC LIMIT 1000

panels.description: Logs of managed-service pods, for every provider. Alloy only collects pods with the log-collection label.
